title: Remediate dependency vulnerabilities (8 critical, 11 high, 13 medium)
description: Red Hat vulnerability checker (rhtpa/osv-github) flagged 33 unique vulnerabilities in go.mod dependencies. Trivy scan confirms 55 findings dominated by: grpc v1.75.0, golang.org/x/crypto v0.41.0, x/net v0.43.0, otel v1.37.0, docker/docker v28.2.2, go-jose v4.1.1. Fix by bumping to patched versions without breaking the build/tests. 4 findings have no upstream fix yet.
close_reason: All fixable vulnerabilities remediated. 55 findings reduced to 1 (GO-2026-5932 x/crypto, no upstream fix available). Build and tests verified.

title: Fix pre-existing test/build failures unrelated to dependencies
description: Found during vuln remediation (gostart-cnk), all reproduce on HEAD: (1) go vet printf failure at errors/errors.go:305 non-constant format string breaks 'go test ./errors'; (2) api TestErrorHandling/ValidationError expects ValidationError or INTERNAL_ERROR but gets VALIDATION_ERROR; (3) query tilde_wildcard_test.go:375-395 is flaky - map iteration order makes SQL param assertions nondeterministic; (4) cmd/test-1 and cmd/quickstart (untracked) don't compile against current API.
